# Ironguard IT

> Managed IT, cybersecurity and infrastructure for growing, multi-site companies
> (50-500 employees). Based in Carlsbad, California, serving San Diego County and
> multi-site teams across the United States. Tagline: "IT that takes ownership."

Pricing is public: managed IT starts at $150 per user per month, with engagements priced
between $150 and $200 per user depending on security requirements, sites and onsite needs.
The service covers employee support, a security baseline (identity, MFA, endpoints, email,
backup), Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration, device lifecycle, vendor
management and executive reporting. Dedicated onsite coverage, hardware, travel and major
projects are scoped separately, in writing. Managed plans start at 25 users.

Ironguard is a team-based provider: leadership, IT operations and support, with vetted
specialists for projects. Platforms supported include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS,
Dell, Lenovo, Cisco and Meraki. A monthly license and spend review is included in managed
service. AI governance is a core offering.
